title: Through the Looking Glass: the Context of Mental Health
content: Over the last few decades, public perspectives on mental health have significantly shifted in a considerable proportion of Western society. In my lifetime I have seen such perspectives go from being a taboo topic and a sign of weakness, to later being a ‘call for attention’ by ‘these new generations’. Only in recent years has it become not only an acceptable topic of discussion, but an important one that transcends the personal and professional spheres. While when I began my professional career, the advice was to separate completely the person from the professional, I have seen with great pride that we now conceive and value the individual as a whole. And as such, many professional environments now value and promote practices that safeguard mental health. Modern leadership is also judged on the same foundation, altogether for the better.
